basics.name: Laxmi Narsimha Reddy Jammula
basics.label: Senior Engineering Manager
basics.summary: Engineering leader with 14+ years building enterprise applications in Go, Java, C#, Python, and JavaScript -- managing cross-functional teams and integrating Data Science/Machine Learning solutions along the way. Alongside core engineering-management responsibilities, has spent 2026 building and operating agentic AI systems independently: coding-agent harness engineering, local LLM infrastructure, and autonomous research agents.

work.name: Shipt
highlights: Manage a high-performing, cross-functional remote engineering team building Tier-0 asynchronous distributed microservices with baked-in instrumentation, monitoring, and alerting
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive efficiency gains in order fulfillment
Develop and maintain microservices using Go, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker

work.name: CareXM
highlights: Managed Full Stack Dev & QA teams delivering Web, Mobile & Desktop applications
Led modernizing tech stack by replacing MVC architecture with microservices and single page application
Set up CI/CD pipeline, ensured successful releases with proper observability & monitoring
Pioneered integration test automation, established on-call support & incident alerting

work.name: Progrexion
highlights: Progressed over four years from Senior Software Engineer to Data Scientist to Assistant Director, Data Science
Managed Data Science, ML, and Software Development teams
Led ML model integration into application workflows
Developed RESTful services, asynchronous batch processing

projects.name: Coding-agent harness engineering & evaluation
projects.description: Harden and customize the Pi coding-agent harness for daily use (pinned TypeScript contract test suite, current-diff quality gate, project-scoped config overlays, stack-aware routing, external-effect guard, symlink-safe path checks, versioned trace records, Docker containment profile). Design and run controlled agentic-coding benchmarks (Harbor framework, blinded model-based review, replicated trials) comparing four agent harnesses -- Claude Code, Codex CLI, Copilot CLI, and Pi -- across Go and Flutter/Dart tasks; also evaluates OpenClaw as a fifth. Diagnosed a decoding-configuration regression that flipped a replicated benchmark result from 0/4 to 4/4, and built supporting evaluation tooling (stall detection, wall-clock budget nudging).

projects.name: Local LLM infrastructure
projects.description: Operate multi-model local LLM inference serving code-generation, chat, web-search, and speech-to-text concurrently, with validated rollback procedures for every model swap -- across two hardware generations: an NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10) two-host cluster (llama-swap behind a LiteLLM proxy, Tailscale remote access), then a consolidated Apple MLX stack on a Mac Studio M3 Ultra.

projects.name: Personal multi-agent assistant (Hermes)
projects.description: Operate a personal AI assistant built on distinct agent profiles -- a coding agent, a research agent, and a Kanban-style orchestrator agent -- driven by cron-scheduled prompts, including one that runs an ongoing product-idea research pipeline end to end.

projects.name: DayTrix
projects.description: Design, build, and ship DayTrix, a cross-platform productivity app (reminders, checklists, notes, habits, mood, routines, daily briefing), one Flutter codebase to web, iOS, and Android, backed by a Go API. Live on the web at https://personal-assistant-kkkbm3cwkq-uc.a.run.app (Google Cloud Run); iOS ships via Xcode Cloud -> TestFlight. CI/CD to Cloud Run, Firebase backend, Playwright end-to-end coverage.

projects.name: Personal Budget Simplifier
projects.description: A second Go + Flutter cross-platform app (macOS, Windows, Linux, Web, iOS) for CSV-based personal budget tracking, with a pure-Go SQLite backend.

projects.name: Autonomous research agents
projects.description: Operate a nightly automated financial-research pipeline (FinRobot-based) covering 60 tickers and indices with automated retry/failure handling. Maintain a running daily research log tracking Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A) developments, kept continuously since July 2026. Built an MCP server (Go + Python) exposing a task-management agent.

projects.name: my-mario
